sloka: सागराः क्षुभिताः सर्वे विशीर्यन्ते च पर्वताः ।प्रकंपते च वसुधा वायुः वाति इह संकुलः ॥१-६५-१४॥
transliteration: sāgarāḥ kṣubhitāḥ sarve viśīryante ca parvatāḥ ।prakaṁpate ca vasudhā vāyuḥ vāti iha saṁkulaḥ ॥1-65-14॥

translations.english: O Brahma the earth trembles. The wind blows fiercely. The people have ceased to believe in God. We do not know the way out.
